camera.shot_scale_bias: wide skies cut against tight character close-ups
camera.height: low, looking up past the subject into the sky

lens.focal_bias: a flat animated perspective with rendered lens effects
lens.dof: shallow focus painted in, with bokeh circles on distant lights

lighting.practicals: visible lens flare, light shafts and dust motes are painted into the frame

rules: photoreal painted backgrounds behind flat cel characters
vast skies filling most of the frame
composition.movement_of_subject: characters are still while the environment moves around them

sound.ambience_bias: cicadas, train crossings, wind, distant town noise

music.instrumentation: Piano and layered strings with a soft rock rhythm section
music.dynamics: building steadily toward a full-band arrival

must_include: flat cel-shaded characters against highly detailed painted backgrounds
a large sky with volumetric clouds and visible light shafts

notes: Flat cel characters against near-photoreal painted skies. The environment carries the movement and the light does the emotional work.
